# Dangling Dice Studios™
> Where beat production meets code craft, phone apps, and developer tools.

Dangling Dice Studios™ is an independent software development, music production, gaming audio lab, and cloud developer tooling platform founded by Jacob Yancey.

## Official Web Properties & Multi-Tenant Subdomains
- **Main Studio Portal**: https://dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **Beats Studio & Audio Lab**: https://beats.dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **Media Converter (320kbps MP3 / 1080p MP4)**: https://media.dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **Developer Suite & Sandboxes**: https://dev.dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **Gaming Lab (Footstep EQ & Game Configs)**: https://games.dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **Dedicated Public API Gateway**: https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **Rx Savings Watch (Web App)**: https://rx.dangling-dice-studios.com/
- **YouTube Channel**: https://www.youtube.com/@danglingdicestudios
- **Google Play — Tutor Calculator**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.danglingdicestudios.aicalculator
- **Google Play — Rx Savings Watch**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.danglingdicestudios.rx
- **Google Play — Dangling Dice VPN**: Coming soon (WireGuard zero-log Android app finishing Play Store testing)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/jacobyancey-bit

---

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Dangling Beats Studio (Audio Workstation & MIDI Lab)
- URL: `https://beats.dangling-dice-studios.com/`
- Full in-browser audio workstation: Chord Progression MIDI Generator, Modal Scale Fretboard, Delay/Reverb BPM Timing Calculators, Audio Loop Chopper, Euclidean Sequencer, and Web MIDI USB Hardware Controller.
- Multitrack MIDI export (.mid) and chopped WAV sample stems download.
- Zero-egress audio asset delivery powered by Cloudflare R2 object storage (`dangling-dice-assets`).

### 2. URL to MP3 / MP4 High-Speed Media Converter
- URL: `https://media.dangling-dice-studios.com/`
- In-browser media extraction tool with zero popups, zero intrusive ads, and zero server logging.
- Extracts clean 320kbps MP3 audio and 1080p MP4 video directly to the user's local Downloads folder.

### 3. Developer Suite & Compute Sandboxes
- URL: `https://dev.dangling-dice-studios.com/`
- Sub-15ms REST API microservices, interactive code sandboxes, and developer tools.
- Connected Railway MicroVM execution playground:
  - Quadratic equation solver & symbolic tutor
  - Multi-agent web metadata scraper with SSRF protection
- Full OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification at `https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/openapi.json`.

### 4. Gaming Lab & Audio Configs
- URL: `https://games.dangling-dice-studios.com/`
- Free competitive game settings catalog: 10-band footstep EQ curves for SteelSeries Sonar & Equalizer APO, controller deadzones & response curves, and CS2 autoexec configurations.

### 5. Android Mobile Applications
- **AI Calculator**: Published on Google Play Store with smart equation recognition and step-by-step problem solver.

- **Schema Transformer, Code Generator & DB API**: https://rapidapi.com/JacobYancey-zSna1bjQ-/api/schema-transformer-code-generator-and-db-api
- **GIS Land Acreage, Polygon Math & GPS API**: https://rapidapi.com/JacobYancey-zSna1bjQ-/api/gis-land-acreage-polygon-math-and-gps-api
- **Financial Math, Loan Amortization & Cashflow API**: https://rapidapi.com/JacobYancey-zSna1bjQ-/api/financial-math-loan-amortization-and-cashflow-api

### Direct Studio API Endpoints
- `GET https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/live`: Kubernetes / Docker / Render sub-5ms liveness probe.
- `GET https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/ready`: Database & cache readiness probe.
- `GET https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/health`: Real-time system diagnostics, MongoDB connection state, and live request/crawler telemetry.
- `GET https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/api/storage/status`: Zero-egress Cloudflare R2 object storage status.
- `GET https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/api/storage/download/:filename`: Direct 302 edge redirect download for sound kits and audio stems.
- `POST https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/v1/compute/calculator`: Railway-connected symbolic calculator microservice.
- `POST https://api.dangling-dice-studios.com/v1/compute/scraper`: Multi-agent structured web scraper microservice.
- `GET https://dangling-dice-studios.com/api/oembed`: Standard oEmbed 1.0 endpoint for rich Discord, Reddit, and Twitter previews.
